ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to make "Closed reasons" field mandatory, when an opportunity is closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( CreatedBy.FirstName = 'Data'), NOT (( $User.Id = '00590000004hkga') || ( $User.Id = '00590000003LpZL')), /*FTEOH,RSHARMA*/ NOT ( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Global Opportunity")), /*Global Opportunity*/ OR ( AND ( ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed - Accepted') , (ISBLANK( Closed_Reasons__c)) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed - Not Accepted') , (ISBLANK( Closed_Reasons__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a closed reason, when an opportunity is closed.
